objective: Research Navigator Phase 1 (source reconciliation) plus the read-only HTML view of that derived index. Introduce a READ-ONLY indexer scripts/governance/nav_reconcile.py that reads the five declared research/documentation source inventories (DOC_TRACKING_INDEX.xlsx Master_Index, RESEARCH_SCRIPTS_INTENT_TRACKER.xlsx/.csv, scripts_business_functionality.xlsx, Infrastructure Inventory.xlsx Assets+Relationships, and the local SSOT framework inventory output) and emits a derived reconciliation report + JSONL. It accounts for 100% of in-scope records and surfaces unresolved identity matches, conflicting intent, authority disagreements, missing links and unverified relationships. It performs ZERO joins that are not evidence-backed, mutates no source artifact, executes no repository script, and makes no economic/trading claim. The same command fills ui_kits/research_navigator/template.html into data/nav_index/index.html. The page embeds the JSON so it opens from disk, searches and filters fields that already exist, and does not record decisions. It formalizes the Research SSOT Framework v0.1 ARCHITECTURE.md 'read-only overlap map' phase as a governed UI initiative.
change_class_rationale: No new change class is introduced. SCRIPT_LIFECYCLE_CHANGE already governs registering a new script under scripts/** and its SITS floor (test_script_registry/test_script_matrix_sync/test_construction_protocol) is exactly the floor validate-completion enforces for any declared scripts/**/*.py. Adding a bespoke READ_ONLY_NAVIGATION_INDEX class would add zero mechanical enforcement (the read-only / no-execution / no-source-mutation invariants live in authority_NOT_granted + production_behavior_changed=NO, as RUN_IDENTITY_CHANGE does) and would break test_contracts_registry_wellformed's len(c)==19 pin, forcing a governed test edit. Registration rides an OVERLAY in seed_script_registry.py (matching the construction_protocol.py / semantic_os_integration.py precedent), so the grandfather pin == stubs path set is unchanged.
affected_scripts: One new read-only script: scripts/governance/nav_reconcile.py (category GOVERNANCE, lifecycle ACTIVE, implementation_status LOGIC_IN_SCRIPT, authority inventory). It imports only stdlib + openpyxl (already a repo dependency) and never executes other repository scripts.
